title: Regulation E Error Resolution with AI Agents: A 1005.11 Playbook for Dispute Intake
summary: Reg E error resolution has hard, statutory timing: 10 business days, provisional credit, 45 and 90 day windows. How to put an AI agent on dispute intake without missing a clock, and the verbal-claim trigger that keeps it compliant.
